dataset.train_split: First 4 hours of 6-hour run: created_block_time in [min_bt, min_bt + 14400)
dataset.test_split: Last 2 hours of 6-hour run (with full 30m maturity window): created_block_time in [min_bt + 14400, max_bt - 1800]

entry_gates.distinct_non_bot_buyers_min_N: Variant-defined N at evaluation time t (excluding wallets active in >=50 mints and wallets that round-trip buy+sell the same mint within 60s up to time t)

execution_and_fill_model.constant_product_formula: On entry at trigger_slot + latency_slots: take the bonding curve virtual reserves (v_sol, v_tok) immediately after the last trade at or before trigger_slot + latency_slots. Net SOL into curve = sol_in * (1 - 0.0125); tokens_out = floor(v_tok * net_sol_in / (v_sol + net_sol_in)). On exit at exit_slot: take (v_sol_exit, v_tok_exit) at or before exit target (or at stop-loss breach trade); gross_sol_out = v_sol_exit * tokens_out / (v_tok_exit + tokens_out); net_sol_out = gross_sol_out * (1 - 0.0125) - network_fee_sol.

failed_landing_rate_model.source: Empirical S+0 and window failure audit (reports/route_b_failure_taxonomy.json & reports/s0_cluster_audit.json)
failed_landing_rate_model.application: Each triggered entry faces the empirical failed-landing probability p_fail = 45/76 = 59.21% (S+0) and sensitivity p_fail = 227/849 = 26.74% (window), paying failed tx fee on non-landed attempts and realizing both conditional-on-landing return and expected return across landing outcomes.

exit_rules.stop_loss_rule: Evaluated both as (a) pure fixed-horizon exit at {1m, 2m, 5m, 10m, 30m} after entry, and (b) fixed-horizon exit paired with a -30% stop-loss triggered on the first subsequent trade (+2 slot execution delay) where mark-to-market net exit value drops <= -30.0% below entry SOL.

Evaluate at t = +300s (+5m): distinct non-bot buyers >= 15, creator <= 3%, top-10 <= 18%, MC <= $16,000

selection_and_reporting_protocol.train_selection_criterion: Highest mean net return excluding top trade (at 5m fixed horizon with -30% stop-loss, 2-slot latency) on the 4-hour train split among variants with >= 10 train trades (or highest sample size if <10).
